title: Dia Browser waitlist bar
description: A cream arc rising from the bottom edge, a very wide ellipse with a faint upward shadow, carrying a long black pill CTA and one quiet line of small print under it. 200px tall on phones (full-width button), 152px from lg (443px button).
notes: the arc is filled with the page background, so put it over something else (a hero photo, a docked page) for the curve to show
buttonLayers wraps the button in extra divs for scroll animations (see diabrowser-waitlist-dock)
